claude_proposed_widenings.name: condition_immunity
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Gaseous Form grants immunity to the Prone condition. This is categorically distinct from remove_condition (which retroactively removes an active condition) — immunity prevents the condition from being applied at all. No v4 atom covers this. The v4 taxonomy lists apply_condition and remove_condition but has no immunity variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it has Immunity to the Prone condition

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation: effect_bundle (or array<OngoingOperation>)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current OngoingOperation union only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. Gaseous Form applies a simultaneous bundle of persistent effects (resistance to B/P/S, advantage on STR/DEX/CON saves, hover, fly speed, action restrictions, condition immunity) as a single coherent transformation. No single existing OngoingOperation variant can carry this. Either a new 'effect_bundle' variant or widening the field to ReadonlyArray<OngoingOperation> (plus adding new operation kinds for resistance, advantage, speed, etc.) is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The target has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; it has Immunity to the Prone condition; and it has Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. The target can't talk or manipulate objects ... can't attack or cast spells.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration: conditional_expiry (hp_drop or self_action)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell has two early-termination conditions that are neither concentration-break nor time expiry: (1) target drops to 0 HP, (2) target spends its Magic action to end it voluntarily. Neither maps to existing Duration variants. A new conditional_expiry shape (or extension of the Duration union) is needed to represent these.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends on the target if it drops to 0 Hit Points or if it takes a Magic action to end the spell on itself.
